onset.Description: Time of event onset relative to the start of the acquisition, in seconds.

duration.Description: Duration of the event, in seconds.

trial_type.Description: Categorical label indicating the condition or type of trial.

Levels.NoResp: Stumulus with no button press at either study OR test

response.Description: The button or key pressed by the participant in response to the stimulus.

response_time.Description: Time elapsed between stimulus onset and participant response, in seconds. n/a if no response was recorded.
